Who I Work With
I work with builders who can ship — and organizations that need someone who can think.

Sometimes that's a founder who's got something working but needs design judgment to make it matter. Sometimes it's a startup that needs senior product and design leadership without the full-time overhead. Sometimes it's a health organization navigating AI, complexity, and the pressure to move fast without breaking trust.

What's consistent: the work is real, the stakes are real, and they want someone who's done it before — not someone learning on their time.

Point of View
On AI & the future of design
When anyone can ship an app, the differentiator isn't the build — it's the thinking behind it. Knowing what problem to solve, designing the right experience, and understanding where AI tools fall short and human judgment is non-negotiable: that's the expertise that separates products people love from ones that just exist.
— Johanna Campos
About

I am a creator at heart.

I've been designing in one capacity or another my whole life — trained in interior design in the Philippines, drawn to visual design and the emerging web, and eventually building products used by millions.

The thread through all of it: an obsession with getting the details right and a genuine belief that design makes things better — not just prettier, but more useful, more honest, and more human.

I'm currently building Lakatta, a travel app — because the best way to stay sharp is to never stop making. And I'm doing it the way I believe in: from brand to code, with the right AI tools and 15 years of judgment behind every decision.
